response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to event-driven architectures and AI-agent tooling, but lacks direct executive leadership experience, fintech-specific AI production deployments, or a clear track record scaling engineering teams to the required size (10+ to 30+). His background is more aligned with hands-on development and open-source contributions than CTO-level strategic ownership of AI-native fintech infrastructure.
strengths: Proven experience with event-driven and distributed systems, including high-throughput microservices and real-time data processing (e.g., Dunnhumby media, RIDE Capital).
Hands-on contributions to AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators at re:cinq) and open-source tooling, showing familiarity with agentic workflows.
Diverse technical background spanning full-stack development, embedded systems, and dev-ops, with a focus on testability and observability.
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience; current and past roles are primarily individual contributor or senior developer positions.
Limited evidence of operating AI systems in regulated fintech environments or designing compliance/audit infrastructure for financial applications.
Fintech experience is tangential (e.g., pricing optimization at Optilyz) and lacks depth in credit systems, liquidity modeling, or real-time risk assessment.
